releaseNotes:
• App renamed to PS Board with sleek branding
• Proactive Push Notification when an update is released before tapping Check
• Setup Wizard with Enable, Switch, and Personalize steps (Images 1-3)
• Modern Main Dashboard & Side Navigation Drawer (Images 4-5)
• 3-Second Splash Loading Screen
• Smart English predictive suggestions with fast self-learning frequency ranking
• Symmetrical edge-to-edge World Emoji panel (zero right-side gap)
• Dynamic In-Keyboard Translator with automatic copied message pickup and 11 languages
• Artistic Die-Cut Stickers in English & Sinhala (wavy, starburst, cloud, bubble) with auto-clearing typed text
• Clipboard screenshot capture & preview support
